title: Sokoto — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Sokoto: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Sokoto has a population of 815,000. A historic city in northwestern Nigeria, the seat of the Sokoto Caliphate and an important center of Islamic scholarship. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 18.0.
